formal_statement: ∃ (Ckt : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (Jn : ℕ) (fa fb : Fin Jn → ℕ) (fr : ℕ), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 Ckt ∧ Ckt.size ≤ 16 ∧ Jn ≤ 6 ∧ (∀ jd : Fin Jn, (Ckt.lineDegrees (7 + 7) (Finset.Ico 7 (7 + 7))).getD (fa jd) 0 ≤ 2 ∧ (Ckt.lineDegrees (7 + 7) (Finset.Ico 7 (7 + 7))).getD (fb jd) 0 ≤ 2) ∧ (∀ (jb : Fin Jn) (zz : Fin (7 + 7) → Bool), (Ckt.wires (List.ofFn zz)).getD (fa jb) false = true → (Ckt.wires (List.ofFn zz)).getD (fb jb) false = true → ∃ (pa lb : Fin 7), (lb.val = pa.val ∨ (lb.val + 1) % 7 = pa.val ∨ (lb.val + 3) % 7 = pa.val) ∧ zz (Fin.castAdd 7 pa) = true ∧ zz (Fin.natAdd 7 lb) = true) ∧ Ckt.size + Jn + 7 ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun e2 : Fin 7 × Fin 7 => (e2.2.val = e2.1.val ∨ (e2.2.val + 1) % 7 = e2.1.val ∨ (e2.2.val + 3) % 7 = e2.1.val) ∧ (Ckt.wires (List.ofFn (fun vq : Fin (7 + 7) => if vq = Fin.castAdd 7 e2.1 then true else if vq = Fin.natAdd 7 e2.2 then true else false))).getD fr false = false ∧ (∃ jc : Fin Jn, (Ckt.wires (List.ofFn (fun vq : Fin (7 + 7) => if vq = Fin.castAdd 7 e2.1 then true else if vq = Fin.natAdd 7 e2.2 then true else false))).getD (fa jc) false = true ∧ (Ckt.wires (List.ofFn (fun vq : Fin (7 + 7) => if vq = Fin.castAdd 7 e2.1 then true else if vq = Fin.natAdd 7 e2.2 then true else false))).getD (fb jc) false = true) ∧ ∀ jk : Fin Jn, (Ckt.wires (List.ofFn (fun vq : Fin (7 + 7) => if vq = Fin.castAdd 7 e2.1 then true else if vq = Fin.natAdd 7 e2.2 then true else false))).getD (fa jk) false = true → (Ckt.wires (List.ofFn (fun vq : Fin (7 + 7) => if vq = Fin.castAdd 7 e2.1 then true else if vq = Fin.natAdd 7 e2.2 then true else false))).getD (fb jk) false = true → (Ckt.wires (List.ofFn (fun vp : Fin (7 + 7) => decide (vp = Fin.castAdd 7 e2.1)))).getD (fa jk) false = false ∧ (Ckt.wires (List.ofFn (fun vp : Fin (7 + 7) => decide (vp = Fin.castAdd 7 e2.1)))).getD (fb jk) false = false)).card
plain_statement: Fano plane: line l holds the points l, l+1, l+3 mod 7; inputs the 7 points then the 7 lines; line-degree: line 1, point 0, AND the sum, OR the maximum. There is an AND/OR circuit of fan-in at most two with s at most 16 gates, a wire r and J at most 6 pairs (a_j, b_j) of wires of line-degree at most 2, each a_j AND b_j true only where an incident point and line are on, with at least s + J + 7 diagonal pairs: incident (p, w) where, with p and w alone on, r is false, some a_j, b_j are true, and each such j has a_j and b_j false with p alone on. Conjecture.
title: Search: on the Fano plane, an AND/OR list of fan-in two with at most 16 gates and 6 products of degree-2 wires with at least s + J + 7 diagonal pairs
